passing_score_scale: Scaled score; the cut score is not publicly disclosed and is not always 70%.
exam_price_notes: Registration is payment; learning credits or credit card accepted. Instructor-led training completion includes one free exam attempt.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name and photo. Name must match exactly as registered.
exam_rules: Closed-book, proctored exam. No notes, books, or external resources. ServiceNow platform access is not provided during the exam.
renewal_options: Maintain via annual maintenance (delta) exams after each major ServiceNow release and the yearly Certification Maintenance Program (CMP) fee.

retake_policy.notes: A waiting period applies between attempts; the full exam fee is required for each retake. See the Credentialing Program Guide for details.
